posts.title: 5 years at Monzo
posts.description: I joined Monzo in September 2021. I wasn’t particularly looking to get into FinTech, but I knew they’d hired a fantastic team and established a top-notch engineering culture. I was interviewing with a couple of big social networks at the same time. What made Monzo stand out in contrast was a magical kind of incentive alignment: it was obvious how the business and its customers could win together.
